Client-created per-item observations, if any appear in the future, must remain readable to the administrator through the legacy compatibility hint until a separate cross-role ruling changes that behaviour. M. CONTRACT AMENDMENT. This ruling amends the earlier PEDIDO-UNIFIED-EDIT-AND-CLIENT-CHANGE-APPROVAL-DESIGN-R1 sentence stating that item observation remains editable by lifecycle.
